[All pages](README.md).

### [`announce-section.tsx`](../../components/home/announce-section.tsx)

- `AnnounceSection` _component_: Homepage announcement band from `content/home/announce.<locale>.md`: background photo, title, flip-clock countdown to `countdownTo` and the markdown body. Renders nothing outside the `startAt`/`endAt` window or without a countdown.

### [`faq-section.tsx`](../../components/home/faq-section.tsx)

- `FaqSection` _component_: The homepage FAQ, visible, and the page's only `FAQPage` markup: `FaqList` emits it from the same array it renders, so the markup cannot drift from the page.

### [`favorites-intro.tsx`](../../components/home/favorites-intro.tsx)

- `FavoritesIntro` _component_: The favourites, explained to a visitor who has none yet, in two phone stops after the parks near them: how a park or a ride becomes one (a park page with its star just pressed) and where they show from then on (the menu, open).

### [`featured-park-cards-live.tsx`](../../components/home/featured-park-cards-live.tsx)

- `FeaturedParkCardsLive` _component_: Featured-parks card grid with a live overlay: the shell bakes only day-stable structure (name, link, city, photo), so the pages embedding it keep long ISR windows, and status, crowd, wait and schedule land on the client on a 5-minute poll.
- Types: `FeaturedCardStatic`

### [`featured-parks-section.ts`](../../components/home/featured-parks-section.ts)

- `extractFeaturedParks` _function_: The locale's featured parks, with day-stable fields only (no live data): the parks this locale's readers opened most in the build's snapshot (`viewedParksSeed`), then the hand-picked `FEATURED_PARK_SLUGS` in their order, as many as the …
- `FEATURED_PARK_SLUGS` _const_: Featured parks per locale, ordered by wait-time search relevance for each language market (TEA Global Experience Index and European attendance rankings). 'disneyland-park' resolves to Paris, because Europe is traversed before North America.
- Types: `FeaturedPark`

### [`featured-parks-slot.tsx`](../../components/home/featured-parks-slot.tsx)

- `FeaturedParksSlot` _component_: Full featured-parks section (heading + intro + grid + "view all" CTA) — used on the homepage, the blog context module and the bottom of glossary term pages.
- `PopularParksGrid` _component_: Compact featured-parks grid (no section heading) for inline editorial use (howto pages). Resolves the current locale via `getLocale()` so callers need pass nothing.

### [`flip-clock-lazy.tsx`](../../components/home/flip-clock-lazy.tsx)

- `FlipClockLazy` _component_: The countdown, code-split from a client module.

### [`hero-entrance-gate.tsx`](../../components/home/hero-entrance-gate.tsx)

- `HeroEntranceGate` _component_: Closes the hero's entrance window once it has played.
- `HERO_ENTRANCE_MS` _const_: How long the entrance window stays open, from the moment the hero's markup is parsed. Exported for the ken-burns pan, which waits until it is over because every frame of the pan re-blurs both glass panels (see `hero-background.tsx`).
- `HERO_ITEM_IN_MS` _const_: Duration of `hero-item-in` in globals.css. Kept here so the two cannot drift apart.

### [`hero-park-actions.tsx`](../../components/home/hero-park-actions.tsx)

- `HeroParkActions` _component_: The part of the homepage hero for somebody standing in a park, or right next to one: two things to press and two to read.
- Types: `HeroPark`

### [`hero-parky.tsx`](../../components/home/hero-parky.tsx)

- `HeroParky` _component_: Parky in the homepage hero on a desktop, under the headline: big, beside a speech bubble with an invitation, and the two together a button that opens his chat window, into which he hops from here.

### [`hero-rail.tsx`](../../components/home/hero-rail.tsx)

- `HeroRail` _component_: The row under the hero's text, which answers its question: the rides near the visitor whose queue is well below its usual length right now (`shortWaits`, the nearby answer's).

### [`hero-stats.tsx`](../../components/home/hero-stats.tsx)

- `HeroStats` _component_: Server seed for the hero's live numbers (open-parks badge and intro counts), cached as long as `getGlobalStats` says, so it never pins the homepage's ISR window; the client overlays the live values via `useGlobalStats` after mount.

### [`hero-text-panel.tsx`](../../components/home/hero-text-panel.tsx)

- `HeroTextPanel` _component_: The hero's text column: badge, headline, intro and the search field, standing on the photo's lower edge with no panel of its own, since the photo's scrim (`HeroBackground`) carries the contrast.

### [`hero-with-nearby.tsx`](../../components/home/hero-with-nearby.tsx)

- `HeroWithNearby` _component_: The hero's text: live open-count badge, headline and the intro with live park/attraction counts (SSR seed + 5-min client overlay).
- Types: `HeroInitialCounts`

### [`home-location-row.tsx`](../../components/home/home-location-row.tsx)

- `HomeLocationRow` _component_: The homepage's standing control for location, under the hero's card rail.

### [`home-reading.tsx`](../../components/home/home-reading.tsx)

- `HomeReading` _component_: News and guides, the homepage's first stop under the hero: the six newest news posts and the four most read articles of the last 30 days, as the build's seed ranks them (`getMostReadSeed`, which falls back to the newest), on one board …

### [`home-skeletons.tsx`](../../components/home/home-skeletons.tsx)

- `FeaturedParksSkeleton` _component_: `className` is the one `FeaturedParksSlot` gets, so the band's padding is the same box.

### [`home-stop.tsx`](../../components/home/home-stop.tsx)

- `HomeStop` _component_: One stop of the homepage under the hero: its opening (`ChapterHeading variant="stop"`, the chapter's link as its `action`) beside its content, the way the tour's stops stand beside their phones, or over it (`stacked`) where the content …
- `ShotStop` _component_: A stop whose content is a screenshot on a phone (`ShotRow`), as the tour's and Parky's are: the heading beside the phone, which glides as the page scrolls past.
- `StopLink` _component_: A stop's link, under its lead (`ChapterHeading`'s `action`): the page that tells the rest. `onClick` lets a client caller do more than follow it (`ParkyAskLink`).
- `STOP_DIVIDER_CLASS` _const_: A hairline that fades out at both ends, where a new group of stops begins: enough to tell two chapters apart without a band or a frame around either.

### [`home-tour.tsx`](../../components/home/home-tour.tsx)

- `HomeTour` _component_: What park.fan does, shown rather than told: three stops, each a few lines beside a screenshot of the real page on a phone (`ShotStop`), as on Parky's page.

### [`ml-sparkline-loader.tsx`](../../components/home/ml-sparkline-loader.tsx)

- `MLSparklineLoader` _component_: Renders `MLSparkline`, the chart of a model metric's history, on the client only (`next/dynamic` with `ssr: false`). Takes the same props.

### [`ml-sparkline.tsx`](../../components/home/ml-sparkline.tsx)

- `MLSparkline` _component_: ML model-metric trend on the shared parks/rides &lt;Sparkline&gt;. Metrics vary little in absolute terms (r² ≈ 0.9), so it opts into the `fit` y-domain.

### [`ml-stats-section.tsx`](../../components/home/ml-stats-section.tsx)

- `MLStatsSection` _component_: The prediction model's live scorecard: mean error with a sparkline, RMSE, MAPE, R², prediction count, coverage and the retraining countdown. Server Component; renders nothing when the ML dashboard API fails.

### [`ml-training-countdown.tsx`](../../components/home/ml-training-countdown.tsx)

- `MLTrainingCountdown` _component_: Card with the model's age and a live countdown to the next daily retraining at 06:00 UTC, shown in the visitor's local time. Ticks only while the card is on screen.

### [`news-board.tsx`](../../components/home/news-board.tsx)

- `NewsBoard` _component_: The homepage's news and guides as one board: the newest news by day, each day's age and date in a column on the left as `/news` draws it (`NewsAge stacked`), and the most read articles with their date and reading time, under the news on a …

### [`open-parks-badge.tsx`](../../components/home/open-parks-badge.tsx)

- `OpenParksBadge` _component_: Glass pill with a live dot: "N parks open right now". `label` is the finished sentence, `null` while the count is pending.

### [`park-compass-dial.tsx`](../../components/home/park-compass-dial.tsx)

- `ParkCompassDial` _component_: The compass itself: a bezel with ticks and letters, a face cut from the park's photo, a faint rose, the rides as markers with their names, and the reader in the middle. Blue means only the reader and the way to the ride in focus.
- `CONE_HALF_ANGLE` _const_: Half the view cone, degrees. `rideAhead` looks a little wider than this (30°), so the ride the bar calls „vor dir" is one the cone is on or just touching.
- Types: `DialRideKind`, `DialRide`

### [`park-compass-slot.tsx`](../../components/home/park-compass-slot.tsx)

- `ParkCompassSlot` _component_: Directly under the homepage hero: the in-park compass, or nothing. It reads the same `/api/nearby` answer as the hero's welcome and, like it, waits for the mount.

### [`park-compass.tsx`](../../components/home/park-compass.tsx)

- `ParkCompass` _component_: The headliners around somebody standing in a park, inside a compass bezel: which way each one is, how far, and what its queue costs right now (`ParkCompassDial`).

### [`parky-ask-link.tsx`](../../components/home/parky-ask-link.tsx)

- `ParkyAskLink` _component_: The Parky stop's link: where Parky shows for this visitor it opens the chat right here, and otherwise it leads to Parky's page, where everybody may ask. It never invites a visitor the rollout left out; that stays Parky's page's call.

### [`parky-hello.tsx`](../../components/home/parky-hello.tsx)

- `ParkyHello` _component_: Holds the homepage's Parky stop and reports `home_parky_seen` once it reaches the middle of the screen, which the live Parky answers with a hop and "That's me!" (`reactions.ts`).

### [`parky-stop.tsx`](../../components/home/parky-stop.tsx)

- `ParkyStop` _component_: The tour's last stop on the homepage: whoever has not found what they came for, or does not quite know what that is, can ask Parky.

### [`popular-park-links.tsx`](../../components/home/popular-park-links.tsx)

- `PopularParkLinks` _component_: The parks this locale's readers open most, each with a link to its live waits and one to its crowd calendar, because that is how people search: „&lt;Park&gt; Wartezeiten" and „&lt;Park&gt; Andrang Kalender" are most of what finds park.fan.

### [`section-headings.tsx`](../../components/home/section-headings.tsx)

- `FeaturedParksHeading` _component_: „Beliebte Parks", in the slot and in its fallback alike, under blog, news and glossary pages, whose own chapters carry the watermark glyph on the plain page background. No kicker.
- `getFeaturedParksLabels` _function_: Resolves the title and intro of the featured parks heading for `FeaturedParksHeading`.
- Types: `FeaturedParksLabels`

### [`use-load-park-compass.ts`](../../components/home/use-load-park-compass.ts)

- `useLoadParkCompass` _hook_: Fetches the in-park compass's own module by hand once `wanted` is true and never before, so a reader who is not standing in a park downloads none of it, then hands its component to `set`.
- Types: `ParkCompassComponent`
